title.en: Number the Tiles of an Image

brief.zh: 把图像想成一片马赛克，找出每一小块的位置。
brief.en: Think of an image as a mosaic and find the address of each tile.

concept.zh: 图片是像素网格。x 表示列，y 表示行。
concept.en: An image is a grid of pixels. x names the column and y names the row.

body.zh: 放大一张数字图片，就能看到排成网格的像素。宽度数一行有几格，高度数一列有几格。
body.en: Zoom in on a digital picture to see its grid of pixels. Width counts the tiles across and height counts the tiles down.

body.zh: 左上角是 (0, 0)。x 向右增加，y 向下增加。OpenCV 把图像读成数组，用 image[y, x] 取像素，先写行，再写列。
body.en: The top-left corner is (0, 0). x grows to the right and y grows down. OpenCV reads an image as an array. Use image[y, x] to pick a pixel, with row first and column second.

caption.en: This tiny image has two columns and two rows.

caption.zh: 坐标从左上角的 (0, 0) 开始。向右走一格，x 就变成 1。
caption.en: Start at (0, 0) in the top left. Move one tile right and x becomes 1.

caption.zh: 从起点向下一格，y 变成 1。取黄色格时写 image[1, 0]。
caption.en: Move down one from the start and y becomes 1. Read the yellow tile with image[1, 0].

prompt.zh: 哪行代码会读到右上角的青色像素？
prompt.en: Which code reads the teal pixel in the top-right corner?

feedback.zh: 青色在第 0 行、第 1 列，写成 image[0, 1]。
feedback.en: Teal sits in row 0, column 1, so use image[0, 1].
